findings.name: P77_A-P77_E_OK
findings.message: P77_A exists in the repository but never emits this condition

fixes.title: Make the named producer emit it
fixes.label: P77_CHAIN/P77_A emits P77_A-P77_E_OK
fixes.explanation: Adds OUTCOND + P77_A-P77_E_OK to P77_CHAIN/P77_A, the job the condition name points to: the waiting job then runs after it.

fixes.title: Stop waiting for it
fixes.label: P77_CHAIN/P77_E stops waiting for P77_A-P77_E_OK
fixes.explanation: Removes INCOND P77_A-P77_E_OK (and its cleanup, OUTCOND -) from the waiting job: it no longer waits for a condition nobody emits.

fixes.title: Stop waiting for it
fixes.label: P77_CHAIN/P77_F stops waiting for WEIRD_NAME
fixes.explanation: Removes INCOND WEIRD_NAME (and its cleanup, OUTCOND -) from the waiting job: it no longer waits for a condition nobody emits.

findings.name: P77_F
findings.message: JOBNAME used by more than one job in the folder

fixes.title: Number the repeated JOBNAMEs
fixes.label: rename P77_CHAIN/P77_F~2 -> P77_F2
fixes.explanation: Gives the second and later jobs called P77_F in the folder a numeric suffix (P77_F2, P77_F3…); the JOBNAME changes in Control-M too.

findings.name: P77_B-P77_C_OK
findings.message: waited for but never deleted by the consumer (no OUTCOND SIGN="-")

fixes.title: Delete it after use
fixes.label: P77_CHAIN/P77_C deletes P77_B-P77_C_OK once it ran
fixes.explanation: Adds the cleanup OUTCOND - P77_B-P77_C_OK to P77_CHAIN/P77_C: the condition is removed after use, so it cannot release the next run by mistake.

findings.name: P77_OLDNAME-P77_D_OK
findings.message: name embeds P77_OLDNAME -> P77_D but the link is P77_C -> P77_D

fixes.title: Rename to the standard name
fixes.label: rename P77_OLDNAME-P77_D_OK -> P77_C-P77_D_OK
fixes.explanation: Renames the condition to <PRODUCER>-<CONSUMER>_OK from the jobs it really links, in every job that uses it.

findings.name: P77_A-P77_C_OK
findings.message: P77_C exists but never waits for it

fixes.title: Make the named consumer wait for it
fixes.label: P77_CHAIN/P77_C waits for P77_A-P77_C_OK
fixes.explanation: Adds INCOND P77_A-P77_C_OK to P77_CHAIN/P77_C, the job the condition name points to, and the cleanup (OUTCOND -): it then runs after P77_CHAIN/P77_A.

fixes.title: Stop emitting it
fixes.label: P77_CHAIN/P77_A stops emitting P77_A-P77_C_OK
fixes.explanation: Removes OUTCOND + P77_A-P77_C_OK from P77_CHAIN/P77_A: no job waits for it.

findings.name: P77_GHOST-P77_E_OK
findings.message: producer P77_GHOST is not in this repository

fixes.title: Stop waiting for it
fixes.label: P77_CHAIN/P77_E stops waiting for P77_GHOST-P77_E_OK
fixes.explanation: Removes INCOND P77_GHOST-P77_E_OK (and its cleanup, OUTCOND -) from the waiting job: it no longer waits for a condition nobody emits. Only if the producer outside this repository no longer exists: otherwise the job would start without waiting for it.
